mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals strong corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above the 2017-2020 average (100), as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals sustained consumer spending and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above the 2017-2020 average (140000), as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Fed Funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because higher rates reduce the present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic distress, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because of reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0%, as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month AND industrial production falls by more than 0.5% in the last month, the S&P 500 will have negative 20-day forward returns because of the combined signal of a deteriorating labor market and weakening economic activity.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both conditions are met (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp and INDPRO fall > 0.5%), as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 265), the S&P 500 will have negative 20-day forward returns because of the expected reduction in liquidity and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the monetary tightening cycle condition is met (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 265), as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime (defined by GDPC1 > 20000 and UNRATE < 7.0%), the S&P 500 will have positive 20-day forward returns because of the expected rebound in economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the post-pandemic recovery condition is met (GDPC1 > 20000 and UNRATE < 7.0%), as measured by a t-test (p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
